description.en: Hybodus hauffianus inspired whole living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Duffin1997 Fig12b SMNS15150 whole articulated H.hauffianus primary body anchor; Fig12a corroborating body. Maisey1982 Fig4B species head and Fig14D tail; Fig17 is explicitly composite several hybodonts, not single-species fossil. Early Jurassic Toarcian Holzmaden region. Nominal 1m, thickness, rounded soft tissue, color, pose and female-like hornless exterior artistic; not specimen sex identification or scan.
